map.如何使用世界时钟？: How do I use World Clock?
map.世界时钟适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is World Clock best for?
map.点击 + 添加城市，悬停删除: Click + to add a city, hover to delete
map.城市 A 时间 → 城市 B 对应时间: City A time → corresponding City B time
map.选择多个城市，找出大家的共同工作时间（9:00-18:00）: Select several cities to find everyone's common working hours (9:00-18:00)
map.：协调世界时，全球时间基准: : Coordinated Universal Time, the global time reference
map.：UTC+8，全年不变（无夏令时）: : UTC+8, unchanged all year (no daylight saving)
map.：部分国家夏季调快1小时，冬季调回: : some countries move the clock forward 1 hour in summer and back in winter
map.：大致沿180°经线，向东减一天，向西加一天: : roughly along the 180° meridian, subtracting a day going east and adding a day going west
map.• 东京 UTC+9，悉尼（冬令时 UTC+10 / 夏令时 UTC+11）: • Tokyo UTC+9, Sydney (winter UTC+10 / summer UTC+11)
map.多时区当前时间同屏。: Current time in multiple time zones on one screen.
map.跨国协作时对照多个城市当前时间，挑大家都在线的时段开会。: For cross-border collaboration, compare the current time in several cities and pick a slot when everyone is online.
map.北京 12:00 时，东京 13:00、伦敦 04:00、纽约 前日 23:00: When it is 12:00 in Beijing, it is 13:00 in Tokyo, 04:00 in London and 23:00 the previous day in New York.
map.依时区规则，部分需手动。: According to time zone rules; some need manual adjustment.
map.会上夏令时吗？: Does it apply daylight saving time?
map.以浏览器时区数据库自动处理夏令时，但个别国家临时调整规则时可能滞后，重要会议建议: Daylight saving time is handled automatically by the browser time zone database, but it may lag when an individual country changes its rules temporarily, so double-check important meetings.
map.世界时钟是一款日常生活领域的在线工具。日常生活工具，贴近生活，实用便捷。: World Clock is an online tool in the daily-life category. A daily-life tool that is practical and convenient.
